claims.assertion: Mari Swa attributes her worsening health partly to a possible astral attack and says King Ruhr invited her to an Urmah healing procedure.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She frames the cause as a possibility; this installment does not report a medical diagnosis.

claims.assertion: Mari recounts that Urmah gathered around her, chanted and drummed, then produced a soothing collective purr that prompted intense crying.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: This is her first-person account of the ceremony.

review_flags: The source presents an unverified spiritual healing narrative; it is not medical evidence.
coverage_gaps: This is the first part of a continuing story and ends before the procedure’s outcome is described.
